info.title: Agent Commerce API
info.description: AI-native commerce HTTP API. Amounts are integer cents. Writes require Idempotency-Key. Component schemas are generated from Zod.

BearerAuth.description: Opaque demo tokens when enabled (ALLOW_DEMO_TOKENS=1 or NODE_ENV!==production): customer-token | merchant-token | agent-token [agent:customer] | agent-merchant-token [agent:merchant]; or HS256 JWT signed with JWT_SECRET ({ sub, role, scopes? }). Production MUST set JWT_SECRET.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: customer-key | merchant-key | agent-key [agent:customer] | agent-merchant-key [agent:merchant] (or Authorization: ApiKey <key>)

onHand.description: Units physically on hand. Present on GET /api/merchant/products list items.

reserved.description: Units held for unpaid/open orders. Present on GET /api/merchant/products list items.

available.description: Sellable units (onHand − reserved). Present on GET /api/agent/products, GET /api/customer/products, and GET /api/merchant/products list items.

get.summary: Readiness probe — verifies store is readable and writable (no auth)

get.description: Text exposition of http_requests_total and http_request_duration_ms_* counters. No auth.

get.summary: List / search products (each item includes available sellable qty)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous nextCursor

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size when paging (1–100; default 20). When omitted (and no cursor), all matching products are returned.

schema.description: Always { items, nextCursor, hasMore }. Each Product item may include integer `available` (sellable qty) on customer/agent lists. Merchant list items also include `onHand` and `reserved`. Omit limit/cursor to return the full match set (nextCursor null). With limit (1–100, default 20 when paging) and optional cursor, returns one page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when no more

post.summary: Cancel unpaid order and release holds

get.summary: List products (merchant); each item includes onHand, reserved, available

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous nextCursor

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size when paging (1–100; default 20). When omitted (and no cursor), all matching products are returned.

schema.description: Always { items, nextCursor, hasMore }. Each item includes onHand, reserved, and available from one batch stock lookup (WHERE product_id IN (...)).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when no more

schema.description: Bare order array by default. When cursor/limit are passed, response is { items, nextCursor, hasMore }.

post.summary: Approve return: refund by line + restock; order refunded or partially_refunded
Auto-release timed-out inventory holds and cancel unpaid orders
Upsert promotion (threshold / percent / fixed; amounts in cents)

get.description: Filter in-memory audit ring buffer by actor, role, path, status, code, traceId, or time range.
